description: Wire the new per-game-split model through the backend server and the frontend, and retire the fixed-team wheel-assignment machinery end to end. Depends on FEAT-001 (engine model). The To Live screen shows auto-generated read-only per-game A/B lineups with per-game goal entry, keeps the FEAT-003 per-match Submit flow working, optionally offers a guarded per-game re-roll, and drops the Team dropdown and Reset-spin control. The main Name wheel stays an ordinary name draw.
steps: app.py: update the import from engine to drop round1_assign_action and add round1_lineups (and round1_lineup_action if a reroll endpoint is added). In do_PUT, REMOVE the '/api/round1-assign' route branch and remove '/api/round1-assign' from the allowed-path list. If implementing reroll, ADD a '/api/round1-lineup' PUT route that calls round1_lineup_action(store.state, data['action'], data.get('game')) and saves (mirror the round2-draw branch; use allow_draw semantics only if needed, otherwise a plain guarded save).

app.py: ensure To Live lineups are generated and persisted so they are stable and included in backups. In Store (e.g. in __init__ after validate, and in save() before/after validate, or inside bind_rosters) call engine.round1_lineups(state) so s['round1']['lineups'] is populated once and then returned unchanged. Confirm /api/backup includes round1.lineups and that a reload returns the same splits (idempotence from FEAT-001).

static/app.js: in the To Live page function round('round1') (the big template literal), REMOVE the 'Assign teams' panel entirely (the Open-the-Name-wheel + Reset-spin buttons and the assigned-count hint). REMOVE the per-player TEAM <select> column from the 'Player scores' table (teams are per-game now, not a manual per-round pick). Replace/augment with a read-only per-game A/B lineup grouping: reuse the .teams-grid/.team-score/.player-score pattern from round2Page/finalPage to show Game N's Team A and Team B rosters with the per-player goal entry (counter() or inp()) for that game, driven by the match selector (round1Game) that already exists.

static/app.js: keep the match selector (.match-tabs with data-r1-game) and the matchSubmit('round1',round1Game) control + openMatchResult/resultPopup/resultFullscreen flow working unchanged against the new games[].ready (all-10-scored). The cumulativeStandings('round1',n) helper reads state.round1.players[*].goals and a schedule; provide it a schedule shaped like round2's (A/B/sit) derived from the new lineups so cumulative popup grouping still works (sit is empty for To Live). Verify view.round1.games length is still 5 and each has .ready.

static/app.js: if a per-game re-roll control is included, add a guarded button (reuse .danger/.accent) on the To Live screen that PUTs /api/round1-lineup {action:'reroll',game:round1Game,revision} and is DISABLED when that game already has any entered score (match the engine guard) and while spinning/busy. Keep it optional but if present it must not silently invalidate scores. If NOT included, state that decision in findings.

static/app.js: RETIRE the fixed-team wheel assignment. Remove round1MatchForName(), resetRound1Spin(), and the entire To-Live auto-assign branch inside spinWheel() (the view.names_ok gate note, the round1MatchForName lookup, the /api/round1-assign fetch, and the 'joins Team A/B'/'already has Team' notes). spinWheel() must still perform an ordinary name draw: pick a random entry, show it, honour remove_winner, and keep the Remove-this-entry / Add-to-tournament-roster actions. Remove the 'r1-reset' click handler and any r1-reset/r1-wheel action branches.

static/app.js: update the main wheel draw-help copy (the .draw-help paragraph in wheelPage) to describe an ordinary name draw only (remove the 'Landing on a tournament player auto-assigns Team A or B / capped 5/5 / Reset spin lives on To Live' text). Update the To Live title/subtitle in round('round1') to describe per-game random splits and top-8-by-total-goals advancement instead of '5v5 top four from each team'.

static/app.js: update resetStage() and the 'reset-all' handler so round1 players are rebuilt as {goals:Array(5).fill(null)} with NO team field, round1 keeps extras:[]/roster:[]/lineups:[] (drop 'assigned'); after a To Live reset the lineups should regenerate (either cleared to [] so the server regenerates, or left for the server). Ensure resetStage('round1') clears goals and lineups consistently.

static/index.html: check for any element ids/controls referencing the retired round1 wheel/reset (unlikely, controls are generated in JS) and remove if present. static/style.css: no new classes strictly required; if a reroll button needs styling reuse existing .danger/.accent. Do not introduce a framework.
node --check static/app.js to confirm the file parses after edits.
acceptance_criteria: app.py no longer imports or routes round1_assign_action / /api/round1-assign; the server starts and GET /api/state returns a state whose round1.lineups is a 5-entry list of 5/5 splits.

The To Live page HTML (round('round1')) contains NO team <select> column, NO 'Assign teams' panel, NO 'Reset spin' / data-action=r1-reset / data-action=r1-wheel, and DOES contain a per-game A/B lineup grouping plus the existing 'Submit Match N of 5' control and 5-match selector.
spinWheel() performs a plain name draw with no /api/round1-assign call and no team-join notes; round1MatchForName and resetRound1Spin are gone.
The main wheel draw-help copy no longer mentions auto-assigning teams or Reset spin.
Backup JSON (GET /api/backup) includes round1.lineups and the splits are stable across reloads.
verification: python3 -c 'import app' confirms the server module imports with the new engine API

A single-invocation probe script under /projects/sandbox starts app.py --no-browser on a free port with --data /tmp/t.json, curls /api/state, asserts round1.lineups has 5 valid 5/5 splits, then kills the server (see FEAT-004 for the full end-to-end probe)
findings:
app.py + static/app.js reworked. No commit (FEAT-004 commits). Branch feat/per-match-ranking, no push. REROLL ENDPOINT + CONTROL: ADDED (user said 'switch team combinations each game').

BACKEND (app.py):
- Import: dropped round1_assign_action; added round1_lineups, round1_lineup_action.
- Store.__init__: calls round1_lineups(self.state) after validate so splits are populated once and persist/appear in backups.
- Store.save(): calls round1_lineups(state) after validate (before bind_rosters) so saved states always carry stable splits; idempotent so existing splits are preserved.
- do_PUT allowed-path list: removed '/api/round1-assign', added '/api/round1-lineup'. Removed the round1-assign branch; added a '/api/round1-lineup' branch mirroring round2-draw: store.save(round1_lineup_action(store.state, data['action'], data.get('game'))) with a plain guarded save (engine guards against rerolling a scored game).

FRONTEND (static/app.js):
- round('round1'): REMOVED the 'Assign teams' panel (Open-the-wheel/Reset-spin buttons + assigned-count hint) and the per-player TEAM <select> column. Added a read-only per-game A/B lineup grouping (reuses .teams-grid/.team-score/.player-score + counter()) for the selected game driven by the existing round1Game selector, with per-player goal entry for that game. Kept .match-tabs (data-r1-game), matchSubmit('round1',round1Game) and the submit/popup/fullscreen flow (works against games[].ready). The 'Player scores' table remains (now no TEAM column; header 'RANK' + 'Top 8 of 10 advance' footer) for full-round totals.
- Added a guarded 'Reshuffle teams' button (.danger) on the selected game: PUTs /api/round1-lineup {action:'reroll',game:round1Game+1 (1-based),revision}; disabled while sitoutBusy/spinning and when that game already has any entered score (scored = counts.A+counts.B>0, matches engine guard). New helper rerollRound1Game(game) does flush + fetch + state refresh. Handler: data-action='r1-reroll' with data-match=0-based game.
- cumulativeStandings('round1',n): schedule fallback now derives {A:teams.A+teams.B,B:[],sit:[]} from view.round1.games[g].teams (sit always empty; every player plays every game) so To Live cumulative popups group correctly.
- RETIRED fixed-team wheel assignment: deleted round1MatchForName() and resetRound1Spin(); removed the entire To-Live auto-assign branch in spinWheel() (names_ok note, round1MatchForName lookup, /api/round1-assign fetch, 'joins Team'/'already has Team' notes). spinWheel() now does a plain name draw (random entry, show it, honour remove_winner, keep Remove-entry/Add-to-roster). Removed the r1-reset click handler (replaced by r1-reroll).
- wheelPage() .draw-help copy updated to describe a plain name draw (no auto-assign/5-5 cap/Reset-spin). To Live title/subtitle updated to 'per-game fresh random 5v5 split (cosmetic), top eight of ten advance'.
- resetStage(): round1 no longer sets d.team=''; now clears state.round1.lineups=[] so the server regenerates. reset-all handler: round1 players rebuilt as {goals:Array(5).fill(null)} (no team), round1 object keeps roster:[]/extras:[]/lineups:[] (no 'assigned').
- static/index.html / style.css: no retired-control ids present (controls are JS-generated); reused existing .teams-grid/.team-score/.player-score/.danger classes, no new CSS.

VERIFICATION:
- node --check static/app.js -> JS OK.
- python3 -c 'import app' -> APP OK (new engine API).
- Single-script live probe under /projects/sandbox: started python3 app.py --no-browser --port 8791 --data /tmp/t.json inside the script, curled /api/state + /api/backup, asserted round1.lineups is a 5-entry list of valid 5/5 partitions of p1..p10, backup carries the same lineups, and a reload returns identical splits. PROBE PASSED. Did NOT run full unittest/UI suites (reworked in FEAT-003; still fail against old-model tests).
- grep confirmed no remaining round1-assign / round1MatchForName / resetRound1Spin / r1-reset / .assigned / per-player team references in app.js or index.html.
